description: 15k ohm, 1%, 1/4 W metal-film axial resistor, 0207 body

evidence.note: Mouser Search API, 2026-09-30: exact match for MFR-25FBF52-15K (YAGEO), Mouser part 603-MFR-25FBF52-15K.
Mouser Search API, 2026-09-30: description 'Metal Film Resistors - Through Hole 15K OHM 1/4W 1%'.
Mouser Search API, 2026-09-30: description states '1%' tolerance; matches the MFR series 'F' ordering-code suffix (1%) on the datasheet's Ordering Information table.
Mouser Search API, 2026-09-30: description states '1/4W'; matches the MFR-25 size rating of 1/4 W at 70 degC on the datasheet's ratings table.
Yageo MFR series datasheet, Dimensions table: MFR-25 size is L=6.3+-0.5mm, dia=2.4+-0.2mm - the DIN0207 body size (matches R_Axial_DIN0207_L6.3mm_D2.5mm footprint).
Yageo MFR series datasheet, Dimensions table: 6.3mm-long DIN0207 axial body; leads are formed to the footprint's standard 10.16mm (0.4in) pitch for this body size.
Yageo MFR series datasheet, Dimensions table: MFR-25 size body diameter 2.4+-0.2mm.

why: Yageo MFR-25FBF52 is a one-family, 1% metal-film choice that covers every axial resistor value this board needs in the same 0207 body (docs/parts/sourcing-notes.md Lessons, 2026-09-30); this value's exact SKU, stock and price were confirmed by Mouser lookup rather than assumed from the family's ordering code.
